description: Segment-level repetition-unit and boundary-phase metadata for the 22 QEVD-FIT action segments. Frame numbers are intentionally excluded. rep_unit defines what counts as one GT repetition; phase_landmark and phase_polarity describe the boundary event.

0153/jumping_jack.notes: One cycle is arms-out/open plus arms-down/close; boundary at the arms-down trough.

0153/high_knees.notes: Each knee drive counts as one side rep; left and right drives alternate.

0153/squat.notes: One full squat cycle; boundary at the standing knee-extension phase.

0153/pushup.notes: One full pushup cycle; boundary at the arms-extended top.

0161/jumping_jack.notes: One cycle is arms-out/open plus arms-down/close; boundary at the arms-down trough.

0161/butt_kickers.notes: Each heel kick counts as one side rep; the knee-flexion angle reaches its minimum when the heel is closest to the glute.

0161/lunge_jumps.notes: One cycle contains the left-right lunge pair; blind GT counts six full cycles at left-foot contacts.

0161/pushup.notes: Confirmed by the five-rep blind GT.

0162/butt_kickers.notes: Each heel kick counts as one side rep; the knee-flexion angle reaches its minimum when the heel is closest to the glute.

0162/jumping_jack.notes: One cycle is arms-out/open plus arms-down/close; boundary at the arms-down trough.

0162/walking_lunges.notes: Raw-frame blind GT: 12 alternating steps, starting on the left, grouped into six complete left-right strides. Boundary is the left-leg-forward phase, so this segment starts on the opposite foot from 0218/walking_lunges.

0162/mountain_climbers.notes: Provisional side definition only; pose quality and left-right attribution are unstable, so the segment remains excluded from quantitative evaluation.

0173/good_morning.notes: One full hip-hinge cycle; boundary at the upright hip-extension trough of the hip-flexion signal.

0173/air_jump_rope.notes: One jump-rope cycle; boundary at the head-height apex. No blind GT exists for this segment.

0173/standing_kicks.notes: Each kick counts as one side rep; left and right kicks alternate.

0173/boxing_squat_punches.notes: Confirmed by the ten-rep blind GT; boundary at the standing knee-extension phase.

0218/good_morning.notes: One full hip-hinge cycle; boundary at the upright hip-extension trough of the hip-flexion signal.

0218/air_jump_rope.notes: Confirmed by the 39-rep blind GT; boundary at the head-height apex.

0218/boxing_squat_punches.notes: One squat-punch cycle; boundary at the standing knee-extension phase. No blind GT exists for this segment.

0218/walking_lunges.notes: Confirmed by the six-stride blind GT; each rep contains the right-then-left step pair.

0218/toe_touchers.notes: One full bend-and-return cycle; boundary at the upright torso phase, the trough of torso flexion.

0218/shoulder_gators.notes: Bilateral shoulder cycle with hands behind the head; boundary at the elbows-forward phase.
